text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool in this session, so the fixes come from reading the code against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the number of days instead of multiplying. It now uses `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing the third title, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of its `[-n - 1:]` slice. It now returns `[-n:]`, or an empty list when `n` is 0 or negative.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string, which broke the year check and `age()`. It now converts the year to an int.
